Problem Statement:
You are given an array of N integers : A. You want to pick some numbers from the array such that the sum of the numbers you picked is maximum

However there is a constraint : if you pick an odd number you cannot pick the number to its right ( if you pick A[i] that is odd you cannot pick A[i+1]).

If you pick an even number you must pick the number to its right(if you pick A[i] that is even you have to pick A[i+1]). This rule is valid for all numbers except the last .

Solve the problem and report the maximum sum that is possible by picking the numbers from the array.

Constraints:

1<=N<=100000
